name: engineering.create
summary: User/Secretary: create one Engineering, its independent Team, explicit role hierarchy, DAG and one Mission. Stable retries resume partial provisioning without duplicating identities.

name: engineering.list
summary: Read Engineering projects in the current participant or application administration scope.

name: engineering.get
summary: Read both graphs, current role activity, Worker execution records, reviews, periodic checks and progress of one Engineering.

name: engineering.activity
summary: Read current Engineering role activity and live project-only chat bubbles without retransmitting graph/Worker/review history. No execution or state mutation.

name: engineering.context
summary: Read the common initialization router, current identity, exact owned chain/node, prompt paths and next permitted actions; never grants Aexus or Worker authority.

name: engineering.artifact
summary: Read one explicitly Employee-published delivery file in this project, with current owner/host and exact file-version checks. Does not grant access to the Employee workspace or unrelated files.

name: engineering.update
summary: User/Secretary: update engineering settings. Structural edits require draft/paused state; changed work and its downstream approvals are invalidated, histories retained.

name: engineering.retry
summary: Resume failed Engineering provisioning using the same Team, employees, Mission and request identities.

name: engineering.start
summary: User/Secretary or its Governor: start the engineering; dependency/review gates remain authoritative.

name: engineering.pause
summary: User/Secretary or its Governor: pause the engineering; dependency/review gates remain authoritative.

name: engineering.resume
summary: User/Secretary or its Governor: resume the engineering; dependency/review gates remain authoritative.

name: engineering.archive
summary: User/Secretary: hide or restore a project without stopping its work.

name: engineering.layout
summary: User/Secretary: save free engineering graph node positions; Characters numbered seats and Aexus geometry remain unchanged.

name: engineering.parse
summary: Parse the documented Mermaid flowchart subset into explicit role definitions or Employee tasks/dependencies. Pure preview, no employees or model calls.

name: engineering.export
summary: Export a graph as lossless Mermaid including explicit rank and task metadata.

name: engineering.import
summary: User/Secretary: apply Mermaid to the shared Engineering graph. Validates roles, unique chain ownership, DAG dependencies and current execution before provisioning new roles.

name: engineering.prompts
summary: Read the engineering prompt folder or a file; user/Secretary may edit existing prompts with an exact content version. Mirrors are refreshed before role/Worker execution.

name: engineering.dispatch
args: --id ID --key EMPLOYEE_KEY --text TEXT [--worker-id ID --engine E] --client-request-id KEY --expected-revision N
summary: The node Employee or user/Secretary dispatches its owned native Worker; saves exact task, receipt and engine, never treats native completion as acceptance.

name: engineering.worker-stop
summary: The node Employee or user/Secretary cancels only this engineering run and its exact Worker receipt; unrelated Worker tasks are preserved.

name: engineering.wake
summary: Send an authenticated project report/wakeup to yourself, your parent, owned subordinates or an explicit collaboration target. User/Secretary and project Governor may wake any project role. Reports retain their real sender and grant no general employee control.

name: engineering.employee-review
args: --id ID --key EMPLOYEE_KEY --accepted true|false --result TEXT [--files JSON] --expected-revision N
summary: The node Employee records first acceptance after actual Worker completion and optionally publishes exact run-relative delivery files for Manager inspection; automatically wakes the unique Manager. A failed review returns the node to rework.

name: engineering.manager-review
summary: The node’s current Manager performs second acceptance; only approval turns it green and automatically activates dependency-ready successors. Rejection records evidence and returns work to the Employee.

name: engineering.manager-complete
summary: The exact Manager explicitly confirms its whole chain after all its nodes passed both reviews; automatically wakes the Governor.

name: engineering.reopen
summary: The project Governor or user/Secretary reopens an inadequate Manager chain and dependent work, cancels only their linked running receipts, retains evidence and wakes the chain.

name: engineering.complete
summary: The project Governor or user/Secretary explicitly accepts the final result after every Manager and Employee is complete; atomically reconciles the linked Mission success.

name: mission.create
summary: Create a durable mission until explicitly marked successful. supervised reminds assignees and a Secretary; independent reminds assignees only. Uses current self/subordinate scheduling authority. Native turn completion never completes a mission.

durationMinutes.description: Optional planned duration for timeline display; independent of timeout and actual run duration

name: mission.update
summary: Update an authorized mission and its reminder interval or assignment; rechecks every assignee. Updating does not mark success.

durationMinutes.description: Optional planned duration for timeline display; independent of timeout and actual run duration

name: mission.get
summary: Read an authorized mission, explicit outcome and reminder delivery evidence.

name: mission.list
summary: List missions in the current scheduling scope. Archived unresolved missions still send reminders.

clientRequestId.description: Only the actual creator can recover its request key

name: mission.complete
summary: Explicitly confirm the goal was achieved, record evidence and stop future reminders. Only success stops a mission.

name: mission.fail
summary: Mark a mission as needing attention, record the reason and keep reminding until success.

name: mission.reopen
summary: Explicitly reopen a previously successful mission and resume reminders.

name: mission.remind
summary: Request a reminder now without falsely completing the mission; pending reminders are coalesced.

name: mission.archive
summary: Archive or restore a mission in Mission views. Archiving does not stop unresolved reminders or clear Secretary counts.

name: mission.delete

name: mission.summary
summary: Read authorized unfinished/failed counts by assigned employee and supervising Secretary; archived unresolved missions are included.

name: question.ask
args: --conversation employee:ID|group:ID --question TEXT --options JSON --timeout-seconds N|null [--fallback JSON] --client-request-id KEY
summary: Employee: publish an application-owned choice question in your private chat or a joined group. Other is always available. Finite waits require your declared fallback; null waits for the real user indefinitely. Saved questions survive new tasks, messages and restarts. Call question.wait to wait up to 25 seconds, then yield the blocked task; do not invent a user answer.

missionId.description: Explicitly bind a manually created mission so subsequent reminders respect this user decision

viewId.description: Explicit fixed task view for a Governor asking outside a running task

name: question.get

name: question.list

missionId.description: Recover currently authorized questions and decisions for this durable mission

name: question.wait
summary: Wait on this saved question for up to 25 seconds without blocking Core or its inbox. A pending response means yield this task; later answers resume the author through the normal queue. The decision deadline is configured on question.ask, not this network wait.

name: question.answer
summary: Real user only: choose a published option or Other with a free-text answer. Concurrent/late choices cannot overwrite an existing decision.

name: question.cancel
summary: Author or real user: withdraw an obsolete question without fabricating an answer.

name: worker.commands

name: worker.command

name: worker.inspect
summary: Read the connected Worker native capabilities, commands, skills, MCP, account, usage or redacted configuration; cannot inspect another owner’s Worker.

name: worker.skill
summary: Invoke a currently advertised native skill/command in this Worker without employee prompts or Aexus tools.

name: worker.steer
summary: Append text to the same active native Worker turn when the engine supports steering. No attachments, queue insertion or task replay.

name: worker.background
summary: Read native background tools belonging to this Worker only.

name: worker.background-stop
summary: Stop one or all native background tools owned by this Worker; never another Worker or employee.

name: worker.reset
summary: Start a fresh idle Worker context with the same identity, engine and workspace. Archive its current rendered/native references; no accepted work is replayed.

name: worker.fork
summary: Fork a supported native context into an independent Worker, preserving ownership/workspace/engine but no running tasks or queue.

name: worker.history
summary: List or read an owned Worker archived context without starting an engine or changing the active context.

name: worker.export
summary: Read an export or explicitly save it under this Worker workspace, preserving native identities and avoiding overwrites.

name: worker.file

summary: Use existing workspace file operations strictly within the current owned Worker directory/host. Never falls back from remote to local.

name: worker.upload-begin
summary: Begin a client-owned chunked attachment upload inside this Worker workspace. Upload alone never sends a task.

name: worker.terminal
args: ID --operation list|open|read|input|resize|close [--terminal ID --data TEXT --cursor N --cols N --rows N]
summary: User/Secretary: operate an optional human shell scoped to this Worker directory and owner. It is separate from the graphical Coding Agent protocol and stops on Worker removal.

name: worker.engines
summary: List native CLI availability on the Core host without starting adapters, authentication or model requests; remote hosts are checked at Worker start.

name: worker.create
summary: Create a clean native Worker. An unchanged clientRequestId retries the same caller-owned record. User/Secretary may omit employee with an existing local cwd. No inference, role prompt or Aexus tools.

name: worker.list
summary: List directly owned native Workers (user/Secretary may administer all); user and Secretary may list all

name: worker.start
summary: Connect the native structured engine without a model turn; resume only this Worker’s saved native session and retain native configuration

name: worker.read
summary: Read rendered conversation snapshots with a revision cursor and reset flag; optional wait up to 15000ms

name: worker.input
summary: Compatibility text-task input. Raw terminal IDs and terminal escape sequences are rejected; use worker.send for idempotent graphical conversation input.

name: worker.snapshot
summary: Read the structured native Worker conversation, tools, approvals and queued tasks; never starts a process.

name: worker.send
summary: Send an unwrapped native task through the engine protocol; busy Workers queue it. Identical clientMessageId retries never repeat work. Starts the configured native connection if needed.

name: worker.dequeue
summary: Remove one waiting Worker task without interrupting the active task.

name: worker.respond
summary: Answer a pending native tool approval or question for an authorized Worker.

name: worker.configure
args: ID [--model MODEL --effort LEVEL --permission-mode default|acceptEdits|bypassPermissions|dontAsk|auto --plan-mode true|false --thinking true|false --fast-mode true|false --native-options JSON]
summary: Change an idle Worker native model, reasoning effort or permission setting; keeps engine, workspace, host and native conversation identity. Connected model/effort changes use native controls; changed permissions require an explicit stop/start before new work.

name: worker.draft
summary: Retain an owned Worker composer draft without sending or starting a process. A stale expectedRevision returns applied=false and the current draft.

name: worker.resize
summary: Legacy terminal resizing; structured Workers explicitly reject terminal resizing

name: worker.interrupt
summary: Interrupt the current native task and cancel queued tasks; keep the connection and history when supported

name: worker.stop
summary: Stop the owned native process tree; retain Worker record, work files and native history

name: worker.remove
summary: Stop the owned native process and tool descendants, wait for exit, then remove only your Worker record; preserve work files, engine configuration, authentication and native history

name: direct.send
args: --employee ID --text TEXT [--images JSON --files JSON --mode send|enqueue|steer --client-message-id KEY --reply-to ID]
summary: Send a private message using employee ID. For a native employee, only user/Secretary may dispatch work. For an external Dot/Grok Worker ID from bot.list, any employee with bot.access may explicitly delegate raw text/images/files; no Aexus context is injected. Native session.send/enqueue alone do not publish private messages.

name: direct.post
summary: Employee: reply to a tagged Message private input, or explicitly requested private delivery. Team/CLI/untagged input defaults to native Agent text; do not call this for ordinary Team replies. Supports text/images/files and multiple messages with distinct IDs; identical retries reuse the ID. Publishes only as yourself; never dispatches work or posts to groups.

name: direct.history
summary: Read only explicitly published private messages, media and delivery evidence; never includes native output, shared inputs, wrappers or silent context reads. Querying does not mark read.

name: direct.send-status
summary: Read an existing private input acceptance without replaying work. Native employee input is user/Secretary-only; external Worker sends are available to their currently authorized sender.

name: direct.acknowledge
summary: User/Secretary: acknowledge an exact published incoming private message. A stale ID never acknowledges a newer post.

name: bot.appearance
summary: User/Secretary: read Dot’s fixed native OpenAI Codey animation. Other Dot character overrides are unsupported. Grok uses its original native shape, color and animation. Does not modify the external Worker prompt or identity.

name: bot.list
summary: List authorized Dot/Grok Worker conversations, native Mac executor state in bot.localComputer, and durable execution/usage issues with reset times. User/Secretary may include removed local connections for explicit restoration. Native bots have no application credentials.

name: bot.update
summary: User/Secretary: edit the local display name of an external Worker without changing its native prompt, identity or configuration. Uses an independent profile revision.

name: bot.delete
summary: User/Secretary: remove a Dot/Grok connection from Aexus, revoke local access and stop its watcher. Retain the native bot and recoverable history; ordinary sync never reimports removed connections.

name: bot.restore
summary: User/Secretary: explicitly restore a removed local bot connection after verifying the native bot still exists. Restore history and appearance; employee grants must be added again.

name: bot.sync
summary: User/Secretary: import existing native Dot and Grok bots/groups without changing their prompts, history or permissions. Refreshes account connectivity.

name: bot.create
summary: User/Secretary: create a native Grok Worker. A stable UUID is the remote creation identity; unchanged retries never create another bot. No Aexus context is injected.

name: bot.group-create
summary: User/Secretary: create a native Grok group from imported Grok Worker conversation IDs. Does not add Aexus employees to the native group; bot.access grants application access separately.

name: bot.access
summary: User/Secretary: grant employees access to an external Worker private conversation or Grok group. Secretary always has full access. Ordinary employee grants permit explicit messaging, history and files, never application authority for the bot.

name: monitor.list
summary: List own supervised script/program monitors; user and Secretary manage all. Monitor execution remains on the owning employee’s execution host.

name: monitor.create

Emit JSON lines {id:stableEventId,data:any}; Core namespaces events, deduplicates and queues wakeups. The script receives no application identity.

name: monitor.start
summary: Start a saved monitor on its pinned employee host/workspace. No local fallback. stdout JSON lines become monitor.output; termination becomes monitor.exited. Use schedule.* to select the employee wake action.

name: monitor.read
summary: Read bounded monitor process output and cursor without creating events or dispatching work.

name: monitor.stop
summary: Stop the managed monitor process and disable automatic restart. Does not remove schedules or user programs.

name: monitor.remove
summary: Stop and forget a monitor; retain user script/files and schedule history. Event schedules lose authorization to the removed source.

name: channel.access

name: channel.fetch-text

summary: Authorized employees (Secretary always authorized): explicitly fetch recent full news text with a reading grant, without saving; limit 1–100 (default 20), newest first. No images, downloads, receipts or model calls. Follow nextCursor for more.

name: channel.fetch-images
args: CHANNEL_ID [--limit N] [--source SOURCE_ID | --sources JSON] [--since ISO --until ISO --time-ranges JSON --keywords-all JSON --keywords-any JSON --exclude-keywords JSON] [--cursor CURSOR]
summary: Authorized employees (Secretary always authorized): explicitly fetch recent full messages with published images; native API tools return actual image blocks, CLI/HTTP return base64. Reading grant required except user/Secretary; no save required. Pages are bounded to 32 images/8 MiB image bytes; follow nextCursor.

name: channel.search
args: CHANNEL_ID [--query TEXT | --keywords-all JSON | --keywords-any JSON] [--limit N] [--source SOURCE_ID | --sources JSON] [--since ISO --until ISO --time-ranges JSON --exclude-keywords JSON] [--cursor CURSOR] [--images]
summary: Authorized employees (Secretary always authorized): search retained news text, titles and source names with a reading grant, without saving. Full results newest first; text only by default, --images includes native image blocks. Combine multiple source IDs (OR), absolute [since,until) ranges or timeRanges (OR), keywordsAll (AND), keywordsAny (OR), and excludeKeywords (NOT); groups combine with AND. Same bounded pagination as fetch APIs.
